SEE.title: See one slanted velocity
content: Start with one launch arrow and fixed x-y axes.

REALIZE.title: Resolve the arrow
content: Project the velocity onto x and y without creating two different motions.

UNDERSTAND.title: Connect geometry to relations
content: Cosine gives the adjacent component and sine gives the opposite component.

MISCONCEPTION.title: Do not duplicate the full speed
content: u_x and u_y are components; neither is automatically equal to u.
